DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

The laboratory results showing anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukocytosis, and the presence of lymphoblasts (CD10+, CD19+, TdT+) on bone marrow aspirate confirm the diagnosis of ALL. This aligns perfectly with the clinical presentation of fever, bruising, and severe bone pain in a 4-year-old girl.
